column1: # Forever loot of the Deadmines (map 36): the boss drop and quest reward rows (spec jvbastel/WOWAI#240, ticket #244).
# The items are in loot_deadmines_items.tsv. The layout of the loot files is in forever/REFRESH.md, "Dungeon loot".
# forever/generator writes a drop row into forever_creature_loot_template: a copy of every stock row of the boss's
# loot entry plus the new row, outside the stock equal-chance group, with patch_min 0 (the Deadmines are open from
# patch 0). A reward row becomes a forever_quest_template copy of the stock quest with the Forever reward choices.
# Sources, read 2026-10-31: Wowhead's Forever tooltip data ("Dropped by" and "Drop Chance" of each item,
# (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=<id>, read with a web-fetch tool, summaries in
# notes/forever/wowhead-cache/quest). A drop is confirmed when the tooltip's "Dropped by" names the boss; its chance
# Quests 166 (The Defias Brotherhood) and 373 (The Unsent Letter) show the stock rewards on Wowhead Forever: no row.
# 92753 (Destruction in Deadmines) is a Forever-only quest with no stock row and no reward item: no row.
# No Forever page shows a lifted class lock: no unlock row.
# Stock boss drops keep their stock chance (spec #240): they have no drop row.
#   kind        drop: a new item on a boss; reward: a new reward choice of a quest (replaces "-") or a swapped one;
#               unlock: the quest reward item loses its class lock (the item needs a row in the items file)
#   item        the item ID (a row of a loot items file, or a stock item)
#   target      drop: the boss (creature entry); reward, unlock: the quest ID
#   targetName  the stock name of the boss or the title of the quest (the generator compares it)
#   loot        drop: "creature" (the boss's creature loot entry) or "reference <ID>" (a reference loot entry that only
#   chance      drop: the drop chance in percent; else "-"
#   replaces    reward: the stock reward choice it replaces, "-" to add it in the first empty choice slot, or "fixed"
#               (the item is a stock fixed reward of the quest: it becomes a choice in the first empty slot and
#   count       reward: the number of items; else "-"
#   status      confirmed, unconfirmed or unreadable (the generator leaves the row out and lists it)
#   date        the day the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD
